title: Decompose chat and admin page orchestration into focused components
description: The 2026-07-11 swarm audit identified that the chat and admin Razor pages are acting as large orchestration hubs. Scope: extract focused partial components or services for chat session/workflow state, trace/approval rendering, admin users/oauth/settings sub-panels, and share the boundary with focused tests. Evidence: Data/Pages/audits/codebase-audit-20260711-swarm-synthesis.md, MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Chat.razor, MemorySmith.App/Components/Pages/Admin.razor.
